title: Playgrounds give clearer answers
summary:
Playgrounds got clearer, text gained a repetition control, model stats got an endpoint, and three community apps joined the listings.

The text and image playgrounds now show more specific generation errors, and image generation retries rate-limited requests when the API supplies a wait time. Hello shows unavailable models as disabled, distinguishes video output in model badges, and runs theme design, copy, and background requests in parallel. Its plants-and-trees preset replaces creatures.

Chat completions now accept `repetition_penalty` values from 0 to 2. A new public model-stats endpoint aggregates seven days of request counts, average response times, and success and error counts by model.

Seedream 4.5 Pro now passes requested seeds through to image generation. Gemini-large now handles reported cached-token usage without failing on a conversion-rate error.

daily.title: Tune text repetition
daily.text: Set `repetition_penalty` from 0 to 2 in chat completion requests for another way to steer generated text. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

daily.title: Seven days of model stats
daily.text: A new public model-stats endpoint reports request counts, average response times, and success and error counts by model over the past seven days.

daily.title: A greener theme preset
daily.text: Hello’s theme generator has a plants-and-trees preset in place of creatures. It also runs design, copy, and background requests in parallel instead of spacing them out.
